profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Nightfall AI
profile.summary:
A versatile and hard-working programming professional with a deep knowledge of programming fundamentals and crafting complete projects from concept to final design. Had worked as Cisco Webex Control Hub (which is admin portal for all of WebEx services) core team engineer. Currently working in Nightfall AI (Series B startup) for building Data loss prevention platform

A pro-active learner who tackles new challenges through hands-on programming of personal projects, learning on the fly and seeing what works well and what doesn’t. Employs a variety of different programming tools, extensions, and libraries to find what works best. Experienced in working in a solo capacity or alongside a team. Eager to apply their skills to a new and challenging role to test the limits of their knowledge. 

CORE SKILLS & COMPETENCIES

•	Front End Development
•	Web Applications
•	API Functionality 	
•	Software Engineering
•	Server – Client Interactions
•	Team Coordination
•	Quick Learner
•	Complex Problem Solving

positions.description:
Front end platform team
- Lead Frontend for Nyx - AI-native autonomous DLP agent

- Built and maintained design system

- Managed CI/CD frontend application pipeline and analytics of the application
- Built Dashboard V2 - interactive charts for usage data in the Nightfall Platform
